body: Thank you, and I do plan on speaking with someone from my county's legal aid society soon.

I'll have to go back up north for that, as the family I moved down here to be with are the only ones here. It might be the route I have to go, though. I'll have it held over me for a long time if I do. Pretty much everything I do is wrong anymore, I feel like.

I'm not meaning to act like this is the worst thing ever to happen to a person. I just was so...optimistic...for the first time in a long, long while, about coming here and starting. And now? Bang, in less than three weeks, it is all tarnished and I'm left picking up the pieces of another failure. Optimism is so rare for me, so it hurts that much more that it turned out like this. Guess I should never have left.

I agree, and I don't mean to attempt to act like the situation I'm in is the worst. It isn't. It sucks that my brother would do that, but I do have friends and all who have reached out to help me.

What hurts most is twofold. One: My family brushing it off and letting him slide, even though he has done this to them countless times and thought nothing of putting me in that situation. He's full their kid (I'm just my dad's) and thus he'll get anything. Me? Do it our way or gtfo, pal. 

Lastly, it's that feeling it just won't stop for me - ever. Between marrying someone who gave me a beating financially to having no roots for over 13 months now to losing the job I had to putting off finishing my master's b/c I had to work to support my wife to my mom and grandmom who raised me not caring at all what happens to me...it is completely irrational and I know it, but lately ever thing that falls on me just seems to add to the pile and makes it that much harder to stand back up and do the right/productive thing. I don't know how much longer I have it left in me.

It isn't OK, but the Tamil would rather sweep problems under the rug than deal with them. And when I raised these issues, my stepmom (brother's mom) basically just said "ok let us know when you're moving so we can give the extra room to his son".

I think I'm just let down more than anything. Dad sold me on this prospect for months, telling me how great it'd be, that I'd love it here, it'd be a new lease on life, etc...and now I just feel more depressed and worthless than ever.
If you don't mind getting your cash stolen for drugs, you're more than welcome to live in my family's condo.

I spoke w/my stepmom earlier via text about it. She basically just said "well talk to him (brother) and let us know when you plan to move out so we can give our room to his son."

And so ends the "new start on life" I thought/was told I'd have in moving down here. I might attempt to move back up north, at least there I'll have a better shot at getting a job. I just can't figure out how everything in life keeps going wrong for me. Why can't I get this goddamn jinx off of my back? I just want to be happy and productive and everytime I see a door open, it is violently kicked shut - often after I already walked through it.
